title: kbext.py loads a group's extender for an extension point from the settings layers or an it_ops_kb entry point, and refuses a missing or version-mismatched one by name
goal: _tools/kbext.py holds API_VERSION and load(point, root) with the standard library only; load reads extensions.<point> from kbsettings.layered as module:attr or as a module; each extension_paths directory is taken relative to the file that names it and put on sys.path; with no setting load takes the one entry point of group it_ops_kb.<point> from importlib.metadata.entry_points; a module's KBEXT_REQUIRES holds lower and upper bounds on MAJOR.MINOR that API_VERSION must meet; kbext.py resolve POINT --root WS prints the point, the module:attr, the layer and its file, exit 0; kbext.py call POINT --root WS --json ARGS calls the extender with the JSON list as its arguments and prints its answer as JSON; a missing module, a missing attribute or a version outside KBEXT_REQUIRES exits 2 with one line naming the point, the module and the layer; two entry points for one point exit 2 naming both distributions

gates.question: What does kbext.py do with a module that has no KBEXT_REQUIRES?
options: refuse it, exit 2 naming the point, the module and the layer
load it and take it as valid for every API version
gates.recommendation: refuse it, exit 2 naming the point, the module and the layer
gates.answer: refuse it, exit 2 naming the point, the module and the layer

gates.question: What is the extender when extensions.<point> names a module with no attribute?
options: the module itself, which call refuses as not callable
the module's attribute named like the point
gates.recommendation: the module itself, which call refuses as not callable
gates.answer: the module itself, which call refuses as not callable

gates.question: How does kbext.py learn the file of the layer that set extensions.<point> and the extension_paths of each layer, when kbsettings has no public reader of its layers?
options: call kbsettings._layers and file bug BG-nhpbkkut for a public name
copy the layer file lookup into kbext.py
edit kbsettings.py to add a public reader in this item
gates.recommendation: call kbsettings._layers and file bug BG-nhpbkkut for a public name
gates.answer: neither private call nor a copy: ST-xx5yzpky (in flight) renames kbsettings._layers and _shown to public layer_files and shown_path; code kbext.py against kbsettings.layer_files and kbsettings.shown_path, file no bug for it, and the orchestrator lands ST-xx5yzpky first and rebases this branch on it before landing

gates.question: Which bounds does KBEXT_REQUIRES accept?
options: comma-separated comparisons on MAJOR.MINOR with >=, >, <=, < and ==, the upper bound optional
exactly one lower and one upper bound, both required
gates.recommendation: comma-separated comparisons on MAJOR.MINOR with >=, >, <=, < and ==, the upper bound optional
gates.answer: comma-separated comparisons on MAJOR.MINOR with >=, >, <=, < and ==, the upper bound optional
